hadith:
Tax (Zakat ul Fitr) - Narrated by Abu Said Al-Khudri -  Volume 2, Book 25, Number 586 

In the life-time of Allah's Apostle , we used to give one Sa' of food (edible things) as Sadaqat-ul-Fit,r (to the poor). Our food used to be either of barley, raisins (dried grapes), cottage cheese or dates.
message: In the Name of Allah—the Most Beneficent, Most Merciful
name:
Al Majeed - الْمَجِيدُ - The Glorious One, The Most Honorable

The name Al Majeed emphasizes Allah's majesty and glory. It is derived from the Arabic root 'm-j-d', which relates to honor and greatness. This name reminds believers of the importance of recognizing and respecting the grandeur of Allah.
verse:
Al-'Ankabut - The Spider - 29:3

We certainly tested those before them. And ˹in this way˺ Allah will clearly distinguish between those who are truthful and those who are liars.
